patterns.name: Announcement bar
patterns.description: 36px tall full-width #0d1738 strip above the header: one centred 14px/400 white line ending in a bold link with a chevron, a close X 40px wide at the right edge. Its 4px corner squares off on scroll (announcement-bar-square keyframes).

patterns.name: Header
patterns.description: 76px tall, white, 1px hairline below. Inside a 64px nav: logo at the left of the 1232px content column, then Products, Solutions, Developers, Resources (each with a small chevron), Pricing, a 1px vertical divider and an AI guide link with a sparkle icon. At the right, a 40px outlined Sign in and a 40px violet Contact sales with a chevron. The gradient ribbon passes behind it.

patterns.name: Framed column
patterns.description: The 1266px frame is drawn as two 1px vertical hairlines running the full page height at 87px from each edge at 1440. Bands are separated by 1px horizontal rules that meet the frame lines. Dark bands and the gradient ribbon run full bleed across the frame.

patterns.name: Hero
patterns.description: Text inset to 208px. A 14px label with a live, ticking figure, then a four-line 48px/300 headline whose first sentence is in heading navy and the rest in slate, then two 48px buttons 8px apart (violet primary with chevron, light secondary with a Google mark). A silk gradient ribbon (blue, violet, orange, pink) sweeps from the top centre to the right edge behind the text. A row of six customer logos sits in a ruled strip below.

patterns.name: Two-tone section intro
patterns.description: 32px/300 headline, left aligned at the content edge, about 790px wide: one short sentence in #061b31 followed in the same paragraph by a longer sentence in #64748d.

patterns.name: Bento grid
patterns.description: Cards with a 1px border on white, 16px apart: a row of two (816px and 400px wide, 676px tall), a row of three, then one full-width card. Each card has a 26px/300 title at 24px inset top left, a small square expand button top right, and a live product mock-up bleeding off the bottom or right edge over a soft gradient. The whole card is a button that opens a large dialog over a blurred page.

patterns.name: Dark stats band
patterns.description: Full-bleed #0d1738 with a soft violet glow. Centred 56px/300 white headline on two lines, then a 1px-ruled row of four stats (48px/300 figure, 16px label); the active stat is white and the others #6480b2. Below, an animated starburst of lines and dots with a small day/night switch in the top right corner.

patterns.name: Split section intro
patterns.description: Headline (26px/300) and a violet button in a 504px left column; an 18px/300 slate paragraph in the right half. Followed by a feature list, a story list or three columns.

patterns.name: Customer story list
patterns.description: Rows separated by dashed hairlines: 40px logo tile, 22px/300 title, and at the right a 40px story button. The first row is open, showing a 1232px wide photo with three inline facts under it; the others are collapsed.

patterns.name: Three-up feature columns
patterns.description: Three columns each with a 40px outlined icon tile, a bold lead-in sentence followed by slate copy on the same line, and a violet text link with a chevron.

patterns.name: Pricing hero and plans
patterns.description: Pricing uses the older system: #f6f9fc page, a diagonal multicolour stripe crossing the page behind two plan cards (a white Standard card with a tinted price panel, a dark navy Custom card with four stacked option tiles), dashed vertical guide lines every 270px, and a floating pill sub-nav (Standard pricing, Custom pricing, FAQs) that becomes a sticky white bar with a gradient progress line on scroll.

patterns.name: Pricing table
patterns.description: A left index of product links (15px, active in violet, groups in bold) and a white card at the right whose rows are split in two: product name and description on the left, fee and footnotes on the right, separated by dashed hairlines.

patterns.name: Docs shell
patterns.description: Two header rows: logo with a DOCS wordmark at the left, a 200px search trigger and an Ask AI button centred, Create account and a small outlined Sign in at the right; a second row of 14px/600 tabs with two dropdowns at the right. Content in a 1008px column starting at 216px. A dotted gradient pattern fills the top left corner. The page scrolls inside the app shell (document height equals the viewport).

patterns.name: Footer
patterns.description: #f8fafd band, 16px/300 #50617a links in columns, a newsletter email field with a Continue button, and a locale switcher.

patterns.name: Floating chat card
patterns.description: Fixed at the bottom right: a white card with two overlapping avatars, a green dot, a bold availability line and a close X; a separate dark Chat now button below it. Present on home and pricing at every width.

layout.responsive: At 768 the announcement wraps to 47px, the header is 66px and the nav collapses into a menu button; the content column is 736px with 16px gutters and bento cards stack. At 390 the announcement wraps to three lines (67px), the header shows the logo and a square menu button, the hero headline shows only its first sentence, both hero buttons go full width and stack, every grid becomes one column, and the chat card overlaps the content. Pricing at 390 stacks the plan cards and moves the price panel under the description. On the sign up page the 1440 modal over a blurred dashboard becomes, at 390, a plain card on a tinted page with the gradient ribbon at the bottom and the Google button moved above the fields.

principles: Build on white. Draw the page frame with two faint full-height vertical hairlines at the column edges and 1px rules between bands; let dark #0d1738 bands and the gradient ribbon run full bleed across that frame.
Set headlines light: Sohne at weight 300 with tight negative tracking (-0.02em at 48px, -1.4px at 56px). Emphasis comes from colour, not weight.
Write section headlines as one paragraph in two tones: a short sentence in #061b31, then the explanation in #64748d at the same size.
Use one action colour on marketing pages: #533afd for the primary button, links and focus. Buttons are 4px-radius rectangles, 48px in content and 40px in the header, with a trailing chevron.
Every focusable element gets a 3px solid #5452fbbf outline (offset 1px on buttons, 3px on text links). Hover darkens the violet; nothing scales or lifts.
Animate colour over 0.3s with cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); the header uses 0.24s with cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95).
Show the product: live, animated UI mock-ups inside bento cards, bleeding off the card edge over pastel gradients, rather than icons or stock illustration.
Dashboard and docs surfaces switch to the grey-blue system: 1px #d4dee9 box-shadow rings instead of borders, 6px to 8px radii, a 4px focus halo, and the system font on docs.
avoid: Bold or semibold display headlines on marketing pages
Pill-shaped buttons outside the pricing page
More than one filled violet button in a group
Saturated backgrounds behind body text; colour lives in the ribbon, the dark bands and the mock-ups
Card drop shadows on the white canvas for ordinary content; shadows are kept for floating mock-ups, menus and the auth card
Centred body copy outside hero-like bands (the dark stats band and testimonials are the exceptions)
